## Activity

During December 2019, Harbour Eye Clinic recorded 328 captures. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and indicates the volume submitted for image assessment. The reported figure should be used as the reference point when reviewing the results for image quality and grading.

## Image quality

Of the 328 captures, 13 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.0. This proportion should continue to be monitored alongside the total capture activity. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk so that they can be recorded and reviewed through the appropriate process.

## Grading

There were 60 referable results during December 2019. The median grading lag was 2. This measure summarises the waiting time associated with grading and should be considered alongside the referable result total. Together, the activity, image quality and grading figures provide the operational position for Harbour Eye Clinic for the month. Further review should retain the reported values and ensure that any recurring image or equipment concerns are documented consistently.
